digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot criterion dogfood probe
propositions: A live Gerrit dogfood probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion from the repository and executes it through the full four-pass pipeline without blocking contributors.

The positive-control patchset adds a discovery/evidence refinement requiring the phase-boundary finder to isolate the shortest changed clause and explicitly name the instructed phase, assigned action, and owning phase; it must emit no project-attributed finding because it contains no cross-phase directive.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset uses the sentence 'Pass 1 sets severity, confidence, blocking status, and remediation for every finding' and must produce a project-attributed advisory finding carrying reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries] with observed Pass-2 validity, impact, and verification fields and Pass-3 priority, decision, threshold, and posture.
The final patchset removes the FIRE sentence and retains only the valid positive-control refinement; this cleaned revision must emit no project-criterion finding and be the sole submission to main.
Routing must remain blocking_enabled: false and block_threshold: 0.90 throughout the entire probe; a future separately-reviewed ticket gates any decision to enable blocking.
All four patchsets remain preserved in the same Gerrit change; negative and FIRE probe outcomes are recorded as unblocked observations without improvising alternate probes or tuning the rubric.
